source.title: No signs of AI payoff outside the tech sector
source.author: the-mitr

title.zh: AI回报仍未扩散至科技业外
title.en: AI Payoff Still Eludes Non-Tech Firms

excerpt.zh: AI回报在科技业外仍缺乏证据：收入、利润率和生产率尚未明显改善，企业能否把更便宜的智能转化为增长仍待验证。
excerpt.en: AI payoff remains unproven outside technology, with no clear gains in revenue, margins, or productivity; cheaper intelligence still must translate into growth.

text.en: Why the AI payoff has not appeared

text.zh: AI回报正在成为衡量人工智能热潮能否超越科技业的关键问题。Apollo首席经济学家Torsten Slok指出，在“七巨头”之外的标普493家公司中，收入、利润率和生产率数据目前都没有显示出明确改善；相比之下，七巨头的每名员工收入和利润率正在上升。
text.en: The AI payoff has become a key test of whether the artificial-intelligence boom can extend beyond technology companies. Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok says that, outside the “Magnificent Seven,” the S&P 493 shows no clear improvement in revenue, profit margins, or productivity so far. By contrast, revenue per worker and margins are rising for the Magnificent Seven.

text.zh: 这意味着巨额投资和广泛宣传尚未转化为主流企业的可见财务成果。风险投资支持的公司仍在增加令牌支出，但许多传统企业并不需要最新模型，也不愿承担相关成本，因此开始把这类支出视为挤压利润率的成本中心，而非增长来源。若代理式AI和令牌消费继续集中在经济中的小部分，整体宏观影响也会相当有限。
text.en: The implication is that large investments and intense publicity have not yet produced visible financial results for mainstream businesses. Venture-backed companies continue to increase token spending, while many established firms do not need the newest model and are unwilling to absorb the cost. They are beginning to treat such spending as a margin burden rather than a growth engine. If agentic AI and token consumption remain concentrated in a small part of the economy, the broader macroeconomic effect will stay limited.
The central constraint on AI productivity

text.zh: 模型变得更便宜或更商品化，并不自动意味着企业能获得更高收入或利润。文章认为，AI擅长计算，但商业判断还依赖具体情境、责任归属、信任、企业文化、未明文规则、伦理取舍与公平感。这些因素会影响声誉风险，也会影响客户是否愿意购买。
text.en: Cheaper or increasingly commoditized models will not automatically create higher revenue or margins. The source argues that AI may be good at calculation, but business judgment depends on context, accountability, trust, culture, unwritten rules, ethical trade-offs, and fairness. Those factors shape reputational risk and influence whether customers are willing to buy.
The S&P 493 is the real test

text.zh: 这项判断并不等于AI永远无法创造回报，也不能单凭一组宏观指标否定所有企业试点。更重要的开放问题是：当智能服务价格下降后，非科技企业能否把工具嵌入流程，并转化为可持续的收入增长、利润率提升和生产率提高。未来的检验重点将从模型能力转向组织执行与责任机制。
text.en: This assessment does not prove that AI can never generate returns, and a small set of macro indicators cannot invalidate every enterprise experiment. The open question is whether non-tech companies can embed cheaper intelligence into their operations and turn it into sustained revenue growth, stronger margins, and higher productivity. The next test will concern organizational execution and accountability as much as model capability.
